entities.name: Trine
entities.description: A fallen angel enslaved by Xarl, killed and absolved by Rahel.

entities.name: Rahel
entities.description: A Serra Angel summoned by Eskil who killed and absolved Trine.

entities.name: Eskil
entities.description: A pure-hearted young spellsquire whose Planeswalker spark ignited; later guardian of the White Woods and mentor of Mangara.

entities.name: Xarl
entities.description: An archmage, Angel-Keeper of Trine, responsible for the Enslavement of Trine.

entities.name: Enslavement of Trine
entities.description: Xarl's binding of the fallen angel Trine.

entities.name: Blackblade-Dihada War
entities.description: War during which Eskil saved the children of Corondor.

events.summary: Xarl dies of old age and leaves the House of Xarl to his spellsquire Eskil.
events.quote: When Xarl finally died of old age, the House of Xarl was left to Eskil.

events.summary: Without a purpose, Trine escapes her imprisonment.
Eskil summons the Serra Angel Rahel to undo the evil done by Xarl and Trine.
events.quote: Eskil, pure of heart, summoned another Serra Angel named Rahel

events.summary: Rahel kills Trine and absolves her, returning her to purity; Eskil becomes an immortal planeswalker.
events.quote: Rahel killed Trine in a flash that blinded Eskil

events.summary: Eskil saves the children of Corondor during the Blackblade-Dihada War and becomes Mangara's mentor.
events.quote: Eskil saved the children of Corondor

relations.quote: Rahel killed Trine in a flash that blinded Eskil

relations.note: Xarl was her Angel-Keeper and enslaved her.
relations.quote: Angel-Keeper of the fallen angel Trine
